notes: FootbagMoves lists Dorshanatrix ("Railing Symposium Mirage") at 7 ADD. The platform reads railing as rooted (0) plus sailing (2), so a railing set (+2) plus symposium (+1) on a mirage (2) gives 5. FootbagMoves scores every railing trick one to two ADD high; it is the only source, so its figure is recorded, not adopted.
